notes.title: Nelumbra - Update 1.0.6
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I have updated the game to integrate the Spanish and Italian localizations![/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Changelist 1.0.6:[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]\[ACHIEVEMENTS][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Discover All Enemies achievements not unlocking [b][i](for players who discovered Hope and Curios but didn't kill them, you might need to encounter them one more time!)[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[LOCALIZATION][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Spanish language[/p][/*][*][p]Added Italian language[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and have a great time in Nelumbra![/p]

notes.title: Nelumbra - Update 1.0.5
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Small update mainly to fix an blocker issue during Hope's fight. It includes the following changes:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Changelist 1.0.5:[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]\[GAMEPLAY][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fix an issue where player's run would stop during Hope's fight[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to Curios' fight enemies spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to Hope's fight enemies spawning[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[LOCALIZATION][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a localization line issue in tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and have a great time in Nelumbra![/p]

notes.title: Nelumbra - DEMO update + Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I updated the demo version for Nelumbra. I think the previous one was not faithful to the full game experience considering it was a really old build. [/p][p][/p][h3]Players trying out the demo should now have the [b]latest updated gameplay experience[/b]. Considering it is a demo, there is a[b] limitation on the Artefacts and enemies available [/b]plus a [b]restriction on the overall progression [/b](only the two first characters are unlockable).[/h3][p]
[i][b]For all previous demo players, I strongly advise you to delete your save and start with a fresh one. That way, if you enjoy the game and decide to buy it, your progression should remain in the transfer. Sorry about that![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I also submitted a small update for the release version including the following changes:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u][b]Changelist 1.0.4:[/b][/u][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]\[GAMEPLAY][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Possible fix for turrets killing players during trials' rewards[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[UI][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an icon issue in the enemies journal tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with hovering animations in the journal menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed couple UI alignments for specific localizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and have a great time in Nelumbra![/p]

notes.title: Nelumbra - Update 1.0.3
notes.content: [p]Hello! [/p][p][/p][p]Here is a small update mainly to fix a boring issue preventing keyboard & mouse players from navigating through the main menu, as well as other changes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Changelist 1.0.3:[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]\[GAMEPLAY][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjustment to the enemies spawn rate logic[/p][/*][*][p]Increased effect spawn rate for multiple Artefacts[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Charger sequence to prevent rhythm issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added a start countdown to Chargers to help with their clearness[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[UI][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing players from navigating through the main menu after a game[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to various UI for specific localizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and have a great time in Nelumbra![/p]

notes.title: Nelumbra - Update 1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Hey, here I am a again,[/p][p][/p][p]I don't want to push an update every day but this one fixes a game blocker freeze players had, so here we go![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Changelist 1.0.2:[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]\[GAMEPLAY][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a visual feedback for SOI attacks (the beloved "crows" ːsteammockingː)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a short invincibility frame at the end of dashes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new dash unlockable in the trials power up choice[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[STABILITY][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a freeze when players were wandering next to the spawn for too long[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, and have a great time in Nelumbra![/p]

notes.title: Nelumbra - Update 1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Hello light bearers,[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thanks to everyone who bought the game, played it and even took time to give me feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]I am updating it to the 1-0-1 version, with a bunch of quality of life improvements, many bug fixes and a small revamp on the Wisdom statistic: it now also impacts the dash cooldown by reducing it. I think it makes sense alongside other mechanics Wisdom has effect on, and more dashes is always something we love 😁 [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Changelist 1.0.1:[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]\[GAMEPLAY][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Various adjustments to the Curios fight, especially on the patterns and the unlock mechanic's clearness[/p][/*][*][p]Wisdom statistic now also reduces the dash cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with totems not working properly[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the global experience curve[/p][/*][*][p]Increased pickup range for all items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pickups wouldn't properly get picked up when player ends his dash close-by[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where MG1s, MG2s and MG3s wouldn't get affected by 5-HTs' zones[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where player could die during victory flow[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where trials' rewards would still appear in the main level[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[BALANCING][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Decreased Perfusion's duration[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased bleeding effect's damage[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Savior's area of effect and heal rate[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Ashwell's drop rate[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[UI][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a button to delete your saves (BE CAREFUL, ONCE DONE, IT'S FOREVER)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a New Upgrades indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes and visual adjustments to the enemies journal page[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes and visual adjustments to the end game summary screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[LOCALIZATION][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added missing lines[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, and have a great time in Nelumbra! [/p]
